practices.title: Farm biosecurity measures
practices.description: Control entry to banana-growing areas and avoid bringing in contaminated soil, tools, footwear, or planting materials. Ask the local agriculturist about suitable farm-entry precautions.

practices.title: Clean and disinfect harvesting tools
practices.description: Clean harvesting tools and disinfect them appropriately before reuse to reduce pathogen transfer. Ask the local agriculturist which disinfectant and procedure are suitable; follow the product label.

practices.title: Use disease-free planting materials
practices.description: Use disease-free planting materials from a reliable source. Ask the local agriculture office to verify supplier accreditation or registration and the planting material's health status before purchase.

source: General prevention reference: Department of Agriculture — Banana Production Manual, Fusarium wilt management. These precautions do not treat an existing infection.
verificationNote: Requested attribution: Regional Crop Protection Center, Department of Agriculture. The original RCPC document, exact harvesting-tool procedure, and supplier-registration terminology still need verification. These summaries are not confirmed RCPC-issued instructions. RCPC III is in Region III; Sto. Tomas, Batangas is in Region IV-A (CALABARZON).

healthyPractice.title: Avoid unnecessary leaf removal
healthyPractice.description: Avoid unnecessary removal of healthy leaves because functional foliage contributes to plant maintenance and development.
